page.layout: One column of contents below a two-line heading; the printed heading is set across the top of the column. Nothing in the margins. At the foot, the partial line "14. De" at the right, which serves as the catchword.

main_text.head: II. PARS PHTSICÆ, COSMOGRAPHIA Physica.
main_text.l: Cap.i. agitur : De Mundo, & quidem Prima ac suprema ejus parte, Cœlo, cujus doctrina Ouranographia.
2. De Stellis in cœlo, earumq; natura & proprietatibus : Quarum doctrina dicitur Astrologia.
3. De Stœcheiologia vulgari, & primum de elemento IGNIS.
4. De AERE, ejusq; regionibus & qualitatibus, secundum Vulgus & Theologos.
5. De Aqua, ubi de Mari & affectionibus ejus.
8. Meteorologia, & quidem primò de Meteororum materia, HALITIBUS.
9. De METEORIS Aqueis ex Vapore genitis, Nubibus & inde genitis.
10. De Meteoris Ignitis, secundum vulgus Physicorum, vere existentibus & apparentibus; Illis quidem simplicibus aut mixtis.
11. De Meteoris ex utroq; halitu genitis, ubi de Ventis, Terræ motu, Item Observatio Libaviana.
12. ORYCTICE peripatetica, seu, de Metallis ex doctrina peripateticorum.
13. Oryctica Chymica, de Metallis & Metallicis ex doctrina & experientia Chymicorum.

page.notes: The top line of the heading is set with a hyphen at the line end ("COS-"), kept as printed. "PHTSICÆ" and "Physica," are printed in these forms; the long s in "Phyfica" has been normalised to s. Item 5 and item 13 show the same long-s pattern; the scan is clear enough to read them as printed. No page number or running head is printed.
